title: The GPT-WritingPrompts Dataset: A Comparative Analysis of Character Portrayal in Short Stories

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the portrayal of male and female protagonists by extracting explicit (via spaCy dependency parsing) and implicit (via COMET commonsense reasoning) character attributes, and scoring them along six semantic dimensions: valence, arousal, dominance, power, appearance, and intellect using static lexicons and embedding projections.
